SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.avatar, u.status, u.last_active_at, u.created_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_item n WHERE n.user_id = u.id AND n.is_deleted = 0), 0) AS noteCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_main_link m WHERE m.user_id = u.id) > 0 AS hasMainLink FROM t_user u
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.last_active_at DESC
